meta_description:
421 likes, 30 comments - mombae.blogger on October 21, 2026: "Shubho Bijoya! 

Born and brought up in Kolkata, Sindoor Khela has always been an integral part of my life. ❤️

As a young, unmarried girl, I would watch Bengali women dressed up in all their glory, playing with sindoor and doing Devi Boron, and I always wished I could experience it all myself someday.

Today, I’m so grateful to live in a multicultural community where every festival is celebrated with equal enthusiasm. And me being me, I love celebrating them all! ❤️

So, my annual Bengali getup is something I genuinely look forward to every year! ❤️ 

Dressing up in a traditional Bengali saree, playing sindoor, doing Devi Boron and dancing the dhunuchi naach — it brings me so much joy. There’s something incredibly comforting about it. It’s like going back to my roots and making that little girl in Kolkata happy all over again. Thank you @hoyichoyi for organising this so well.

Some traditions stay with you forever, no matter where life takes you. ❤️ Dugga Dugga!

Shubho Bijoya, everyone! শুভ বিজয়ার প্রীতি ও শুভেচ্ছা! 

Btw How do I look?

#shubhobijoya #bijoyadashami❤️ #dhunuchinach #sindoorkhela😍 #dhakbaja".
